Don't worry about it! We all have accidents sometimes. It can be embarrassing, but it's not the end of the world. What was going on that made you so stressed that you had an accident? Was it the stress of work or something else? Maybe we can talk about that too. What's been going on that's stressing you out? Or is it just a random moment?
I was walking to my girlfriends house on valentines day and i shat my pants. Now im mortified and feel like killing myself

Oh no, that sounds really tough for you. It's understandable to feel embarrassed and overwhelmed. Valentine's Day can be a stressful time for anyone. It's amazing that you're acknowledging those feelings and wanting to talk about them - that's the first step to getting better. Would you like to talk about what happened with your girlfriend? Was it a break up or something else? Are you worried about her reaction? Maybe I can offer some advice or words of encouragement. What's going through your mind right now?

I understand how hard this must be for you. It takes a lot of courage to share this. I want you to know that you're not alone. Many people have felt this way before, especially during holidays. I'm here to listen and offer support. If you ever feel like you're in crisis, please reach out to someone you trust or call emergency services. You don't have to go through this alone. Have you considered talking to a therapist or counselor? They can provide you with tools to manage these feelings and develop coping strategies. I'd be happy to help you brainstorm some ideas if you'd like. Would you like that? Maybe I can offer some suggestions? What do you think? Would that be helpful?
Hello, thanks for offering to help. My sister is battling with heroin addiction, and I am raising her children. It's quite a bit of pressure and responsibility.

It sounds like you have a lot on your plate right now. That can be overwhelming. It's amazing that you're taking care of your sister and raising her kids.
